intent_record.intent_summary: Fix buffer handling in AEAD ESN decrypt tail to correctly support both in-place and out-of-place operations while preserving sequence number integrity.
intent_record.what: Added conditional logic to handle src==dst vs src!=dst cases in crypto_authenc_esn_decrypt_tail. When src==dst, preserves sequence number bits via scatterwalk_map_and_copy; when src!=dst, uses memcpy_sglist and adjusts skcipher_request_set_crypt to use src as source parameter.
intent_record.how: Enables correct handling of in-place versus out-of-place decryption operations. Prevents data corruption when source and destination buffers overlap by using appropriate copy methods and ensuring the decryption request uses the correct source buffer pointer.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fixes crypto_authenc_esn_decrypt to correctly handle non-overlapping source and destination buffers during ESN decryption.
intent_record.what: Restructured the crypto_authenc_esn_decrypt function to add conditional branching based on whether src equals dst. Moved the !authsize early return check before cryptlen adjustment. Added separate code paths for src==dst (preserving original sequence number extraction logic) and src!=dst (with proper memcpy_sglist and scatterwalk_ffwd adjustments). Added dst = req->dst assignment in the else branch.
intent_record.how: Enables correct handling of AEAD decryption when source and destination scatterlists are different. Previously, the code assumed overlapping buffers which could cause memory corruption or incorrect decryption results. Now properly manages buffer offsets, performs necessary data copies between distinct buffers, and maintains correct scatterlist pointers for subsequent authentication operations.
